skills.name: maxclicks
skills.description: Work with the maxclicks email, CRM, and automation platform: read schemas and attributes; manage contacts, objects, and records; fire and query events; send templates; generate segments from natural language; schedule, send, and measure broadcasts; trigger and observe workflows; manage webhooks and suppressions; read configured domains, senders, and topics; or build a maxclicks integration. Use whenever a task mentions maxclicks, or involves its API, CLI (`maxclicks`), SDKs (Node, Python, Go, PHP/Laravel, Ruby, Java, Rust, Elixir), or MCP server.

skills.name: maxclicks-adaptyle
skills.description: Write or edit the CONTENT of a maxclicks email template: the subject and body in Adaptyle, maxclicks's LLM-enhanced templating language layered over Liquid. Use whenever a task asks to write, draft, generate, or edit an email template's subject/body, an MJML or HTML raw template, an Adaptyle prompt tag, manifest, or hidden block, or to personalize email copy with AI at send time.

skills.name: maxclicks-broadcasts
skills.description: Point a maxclicks broadcast at its audience, schedule or send it, and measure the result. Use for "send this newsletter/promo now or at a time", retargeting a broadcast at a segment, or reporting on a mass send's opens, clicks, and bounces.

skills.name: maxclicks-contacts
skills.description: Create, import, update, search, or delete contacts, customers, users, or business objects (records) in maxclicks. Use for CRM/contact-list operations against the maxclicks API, CLI, or SDKs.

skills.name: maxclicks-deliverability
skills.description: Read a maxclicks sending domain's DNS verification state and records, or list saved sender profiles. Use before sending any email from a new domain, when DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup needs checking, or when a template or broadcast needs a verified "from" address.

skills.name: maxclicks-email
skills.description: Send an email or a stored template to a contact through maxclicks. Use when a task involves sending transactional or marketing email, template sends, or email suppression via the maxclicks API, CLI, or SDKs.

skills.name: maxclicks-events
skills.description: Accept durable business events in maxclicks, inspect their receipts and readiness, list ready events, or connect browser observations through a trusted identity backend. Use for application instrumentation and event backfills using the current REST contract or the published clients.

skills.name: maxclicks-imports
skills.description: Route a bulk load of contacts or objects into maxclicks. Use when asked to import a CSV, migrate a contact list, or backfill hundreds of records. A file goes through the app's CSV importer; data already in your program goes through a throttled records upsert loop.

skills.name: maxclicks-segments
skills.description: Create, list, count, inspect, or delete maxclicks segments, AI-generated contact filters defined by a natural-language prompt. Use for audience definitions and saved filters; editing an existing segment happens in the app.

skills.name: maxclicks-templates
skills.description: Read a maxclicks email template and send it with a matching data payload. Use when a task needs to find a stored template, learn the data shape and recipient it expects, or send it to a contact.

skills.name: maxclicks-topics
skills.description: Look up a maxclicks communication topic (e.g. "Marketing", "Product Updates"), the consent-scoped grouping for marketing sends, and use its id. Use when setting a contact's topicIds, reading a template's communicationTopicId, or building a preference center.

skills.name: maxclicks-webhooks
skills.description: Create, list, update, delete, or rotate maxclicks outgoing webhooks, and verify inbound webhook signatures. Use when wiring maxclicks events to an external endpoint or handling maxclicks webhook deliveries.

skills.name: maxclicks-workflows
skills.description: Start or trigger a maxclicks workflow / automation via its incoming-webhook step, then list, inspect, pause, or unpause workflows and their runs. Use when a task needs to kick off a maxclicks workflow with a payload from an external system, or to check whether a run actually did anything.
